quotes.name: Elijah Brown
quotes.quote: I didn't really have a strategy on my two nights on UNDOCKED. I just flew and tried to make it through as many systems as I could until the time ran out. I ended up even on credits both nights, so that was good.

quotes.name: Brooklyn Nguyen
quotes.quote: To be honest, my mining efforts didn't really pay off in terms of credits. I came out even on both Tuesday and Friday nights. I mined some copper, iron, and sol alloy ore, but it didn't translate into any profit.

quotes.name: P Slayer
quotes.quote: To be honest, my route choices on UNDOCKED Wednesday night were pretty spontaneous. I was flying, reacting to what was around me. I got into a couple of fights, but that's just part of the show. I've been playing to climb the ranks, and sometimes that means taking risks.
